sentences: It's important that we maintain consistency across our codebases.
I want you to always end variable names with '_y'.
For function names, always start them with 'd_'.
This helps us quickly identify variables and functions in our code.
It's important to take these details seriously, as consistent code formatting makes collaboration much easier.
We'll check in regularly to ensure you're settling in well and to provide any guidance you may need.
